name: workspace
//: Repo-level checks over the whole Cargo workspace and the project graph: lint enforces the module boundaries (check-project-boundaries.mjs against project-boundaries.json) and test is that checker's own suite; supply-chain is cargo-deny (advisories, bans, licenses, sources) plus cargo-machete; msrv builds under the declared minimum Rust. It depends on the two crates whose manifests those read; every project.json and Cargo.toml is an input, so any graph edit reruns the boundary check. The coverage gate is the nested coverage project.

commands: cargo deny --locked check bans licenses sources

supply-chain.//: Uncached: advisories change upstream without any change here.

msrv.//: Needs the MSRV toolchain (rustup toolchain install 1.88.0); like before the graph, not part of the gate's target list.
